experimental_method: Isopiestic molalities of CaCl2(aq) against NaCl(aq) reference at 444-524 K in the ORNL high-temperature isopiestic facility (solutions weighed with an internal balance); molar enthalpies of dilution of CaCl2(aq) in the ORNL high-temperature, high-pressure flow calorimeter (thermopile, electrical calibration), 298-527 K, about 7-43 MPa.
uncertainties_stated: Isopiestic molalities accurate to better than 2e-3 times m (from duplicates and experience); mean temperature and pressure of each calorimetric set vary typically +-0.1 K and +-0.1 MPa; for the least-squares fit enthalpies of dilution were assigned a standard error of 2e-2 times Delta_dil H_m or 20 J/mol, whichever is greater.
quality_remarks: Table 1 phi is the CaCl2 osmotic coefficient computed by the authors from the NaCl osmotic coefficient (Pitzer et al.) assuming complete dissociation; printed m CaCl2 = 0.2759 at 473.61 K (phi 0.9531, m NaCl 3.4532) is probably a misprint for 2.2759 (kept as printed). Table 2 printed column is -Delta_dil H_m (positive numbers). The authors state results above 526 K are not treated in this paper (calorimetric data exist to 674 K). A small fraction of the enthalpies appeared earlier in a letter. Temperature scale not stated. Some mi/mf values are repeated replicates.

not_extracted_tables.reason: compilation of literature thermodynamic results (property, method, T, p, m ranges, references) used in the least-squares fit; no data values of this paper
